title: 039 - Largest Row Total
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print the largest row total and prints exactly `6`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def largest_row_total(year, month, day):
    return str(year) + "-" + str(month) + "-" + str(day).zfill(2)
solutionCode:
def largest_row_total(year, month, day):
    return str(year) + "-" + str(month).zfill(2) + "-" + str(day).zfill(2)
hint: The comparison should keep the largest subtotal, not the smallest.
explanation: The broken code updates the best value in the wrong direction. Keeping the maximum row total fixes the output.
